name: University of Waterloo
header:
University of Waterloo
Canada · Pure Mathematics MMath / PhD (including direct entry)
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank =29. Included in Canada top ten including the published band crossing tenth place (11
institutions total). Official QS public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Waterloo has distinct Pure Mathematics, Applied Mathematics and Combinatorics & Optimization
applications; this dossier concerns Pure Mathematics.
• Direct PhD is possible but requires supervisor fit; MMath is a funded route, not an unfunded consolation
award.
• New international applicants are not eligible for Waterloo OGS 2027-28 despite the award having an
international category.
• Some official personal-page links redirect to Waterloo’s homepage; current paper sources were
independently located and institutional appointments cross-checked.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago mathematics bachelor’s can be assessed as equivalent to an honours mathematics degree; MMath
minimum 78%. Direct PhD without a master’s is explicitly possible in the departmental FAQ, with a willing
supervisor. A PhD applicant not offered direct entry is automatically considered for MMath. Formal eligibility
also depends on advanced mathematics preparation and grades; degree completion before enrolment is
necessary. [s2] [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose Pure Mathematics and identify 1-3 possible supervisors; contact referees at least four weeks ahead.
Start the application 2-4 weeks before the deadline to allow document/referee completion. Select thesis MMath
initially; research-paper transfer is possible later. For a direct PhD, resolve supervision fit before applying. [s1]
[s3] [s4] [s6]
Adviser contact [Conflict]
Identify 1-3 faculty on the application. Direct PhD requires a willing supervisor; admission committee circulates
the file. Ben Webster explicitly says he is open to Fall 2027 students but selective due to administrative
work/sabbatical; recommends bachelor’s applicants email him beforehand and apply MMath. His blanket
master’s-first advice differs from the department FAQ’s direct-PhD exception; ask which route fits. [s3] [s14]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Current central portal is grad.apply.uwaterloo.ca. Submit/pay, upload required items and track checklist.
Requests can be sent before final application; required documents and completed referee forms together make
the application complete. Do not follow legacy OUAC/Quest-only instructions if inconsistent with current portal.
[s4] [s5]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Admission deadline and degree rules are standing, not explicitly dated Fall 2027. OGS timeline and Webster
availability explicitly refer to 2027. Department funding amounts remain labelled 2024-25. [s1] [s8] [s10] [s14]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing rule: 7 January for Fall, for both MMath and PhD; no explicit 2027 year or time zone shown. All
supporting information must arrive by that date for full consideration. Do not interpret the later 1 April
Winter/remaining-space route as equal Fall funding consideration. [s1]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Departmental full consideration uses the application deadline. OGS 2027-28: intent 14 January 2027 at 4 pm
ET; award application and references 1 February 2027 at 4 pm ET. However, new international Fall entrants are
ineligible: they must already be registered in Waterloo graduate studies by 1 February 2027. [s1] [s10] [s11]

All application information, including three reference forms and supplemental answers, is due by the standing
7 January Fall deadline for full consideration; no separate grace period or 2027 clock/time zone is published.
[s1] [s6]

Required scores must support a complete application by the program deadline. Waterloo recommends testing
at least two months earlier and allows 4-6 weeks for delivery; the expected UChicago English exemption may
remove the language-test requirement. No separate GRE arrival grace period established. [s7] [s1]

how-to-apply pages; use the offer letter and request clarification before relying on April 15. [s1] [s3] [s4]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
If not exempt: program page lists TOEFL 4.5 overall with writing/speaking 5, or IELTS Academic 7.0 with
writing/speaking 6.5. Scores valid two years; TOEFL MyBest and IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted. Central
guidance also accepts specified Cambridge, CAEL, PTE and EFAS routes; consult applicable current score table.
[s2] [s7]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Expected exemption: at least three years of postsecondary education in the United States completed by
Waterloo program start qualifies regardless of F-1 status. This is an inference applying the explicit
country/length rule to UChicago; confirm three years of qualifying study. A generic English-medium letter alone
does not establish exemption. [s7]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
GRE scores are not required. Departmental FAQ expressly permits submitting strong GRE results and says they
may help; it does not distinguish General from Mathematics Subject in that answer. No mandatory numerical
threshold stated. [s3]

Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Declare all completed/incomplete postsecondary attendance. Upload current unofficial institution-issued
transcripts and degree certificates where awarded; do not submit a homemade grades table. Official
documents are requested after an offer. Non-English originals require certified translation including grading
scale; Canadian French documents need no translation. [s5] [s3]

Required for applicants from outside Canada, including UChicago: senior undergraduate and graduate

mathematics courses, grouped as algebra/logic, analysis, geometry/topology/number theory, and other
mathematics. [s1]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
For the above required list, provide course content descriptions OR textbook names. No separate
syllabus-upload requirement or limit is published. [s1]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three references, at least two academic; Pure Mathematics recommends writers who can discuss
mathematical research and ability in detail. [s2] [s3]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Admission reference forms may be used for institutional/provincial/federal awards. OGS uses separately
emailed references, but a new international Fall 2027 entrant cannot enter Waterloo’s 2027-28 competition.
Other award-specific requirements depend on eligibility. [s6] [s10] [s11]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
During the application, enter referee details and send the request immediately; the portal also has a
send-request action for a saved referee. Public instructions establish an applicant-triggered request, not that
merely typing details silently sends it. [s4] [s5]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
No: the current how-to-apply workflow permits sending requests while completing the application, before fee
payment/submission. [s4]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Completed confidential online forms are automatically added to the application; applicant portal tracks
completion. Reminders are sent 7 and 14 days after the initial email and applicants can send reminders. Paper
or referee-email submissions are not accepted for admission. [s6] [s4]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Portal permits excluding an unsubmitted reference and replacing the referee, plus reminders. An already
submitted letter’s replacement or reuse across applications is not publicly guaranteed; ask
gradapply@uwaterloo.ca. Each program needs its own complete document set. [s5]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
Not listed as a separate required document on Pure Mathematics program checklist. Do not assume an
unsolicited CV upload is allowed; consult live checklist. No public program-specific length/format. [s2] [s5]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No separately titled SOP listed. Required supplemental questions cover mathematical preparation,
publications, supervision choices and additional information; see related fields. Portal calls these PSQ while
departmental page calls the form SIF. [s1] [s2]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Optional supplemental Question 6: faithful paraphrase - supply other information useful to the admissions
committee; maximum 500 words. No additional public formatting rule; enter N/A if inapplicable. [s1]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Supplement Question 4: one-page project/interest summary, required for PhD and optional for MMath;
Question 5 requires 1-3 proposed supervisors. The form is completed online and cannot be corrected after final
submission. [s1]

Research proposal [Standing rule]
No mandatory fully developed thesis proposal. Question 4 permits an outline of a potential Waterloo research
area; same one-page limit. A suitable scholarship statement may be reused. [s1]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Question 4 alternatively permits a one-page summary of a recently completed/in-progress project. No
requirement to upload the complete paper or thesis; no authority to substitute a link established. [s1]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Supplement Question 2 asks for authored/coauthored publications, including research papers, theses and
technical reports. No published length limit or paper-upload/link rule. [s1]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Use required supplemental course list described above; no public page/character maximum. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
No additional standard departmental-funding essay found. OGS requires a distinct package but is unavailable
to a new international Fall 2027 entrant under the current eligibility rule. Do not draft OGS materials on the
assumption admission makes you eligible. [s11] [s3]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Supplement Question 3 asks applicants not currently studying to describe professional activity since leaving
school. General upload formats: PDF/PNG/JPG/GIF/TIF; maximum 3500 KB, except designated writing samples
5000 KB and portfolios 30000 KB; filename restrictions apply. These limits do not authorize an unsolicited
sample. [s1] [s5]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Latest department figures explicitly labelled 2024-25: domestic MMath minimum CAD 30,150 and PhD CAD
31,500 annually; international support is higher to offset tuition, but its exact amount is not published.
University PhD floor is CAD 29,145/year effective 1 May 2026, with eligible international doctoral
tuition-difference award additional. These are gross packages including mixed funding, not net cash after
tuition. Request the 2027 international offer breakdown. [s8] [s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Department promises MMath support for three terms (12 months) and PhD for twelve terms, with possible
extension. University floor can cover four/five years depending on entry route; clarify direct-bachelor PhD
duration in the actual offer. [s8] [s9]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International admitted research students receive support and additional tuition-offset support. OGS
international competition excludes prospective applicants; the department’s general scholarship examples
must not override that current restriction. [s8] [s11]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full-time admission/enrolment, good academic standing and satisfactory TA duties. Department ordinarily
expects 5-10 TA hours/week. Funding may combine scholarships, research studentships and employment;
TA/GRA income has statutory deductions. Tuition is charged; a package is not a tuition waiver. [s8] [s9] [s25]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Standard financial support accompanies admission; offer letter gives components. Additional awards can
change funding and TA load. No separate standard departmental essay/reference identified. [s3] [s25]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Institutional awards, graduate research studentships, TA/GRA and eligible external awards; eligible

international PhD students may receive IDSA covering the tuition differential above the minimum. Do not
assume NSERC eligibility from F-1 status. [s9] [s25]
Application fee [Standing rule]
CAD 150 nonrefundable per program through the applicant portal. [s4]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No Pure Mathematics or central graduate waiver procedure was found in the cited application pages. Another
department says fees cannot be waived, but that is not proof of every Math exception. Ask
pmgradadmin@uwaterloo.ca before payment; no waiver assumed. [s4]

University of Waterloo
Canada · Pure Mathematics MMath / PhD (including direct entry)
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank =29. Included in Canada top ten including the published band crossing tenth place (11
institutions total). Official QS public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Waterloo has distinct Pure Mathematics, Applied Mathematics and Combinatorics & Optimization
applications; this dossier concerns Pure Mathematics.
• Direct PhD is possible but requires supervisor fit; MMath is a funded route, not an unfunded consolation
award.
• New international applicants are not eligible for Waterloo OGS 2027-28 despite the award having an
international category.
• Some official personal-page links redirect to Waterloo’s homepage; current paper sources were
independently located and institutional appointments cross-checked.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago mathematics bachelor’s can be assessed as equivalent to an honours mathematics degree; MMath
minimum 78%. Direct PhD without a master’s is explicitly possible in the departmental FAQ, with a willing
supervisor. A PhD applicant not offered direct entry is automatically considered for MMath. Formal eligibility
also depends on advanced mathematics preparation and grades; degree completion before enrolment is
necessary. [s2] [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose Pure Mathematics and identify 1-3 possible supervisors; contact referees at least four weeks ahead.
Start the application 2-4 weeks before the deadline to allow document/referee completion. Select thesis MMath
initially; research-paper transfer is possible later. For a direct PhD, resolve supervision fit before applying. [s1]
[s3] [s4] [s6]
Adviser contact [Conflict]
Identify 1-3 faculty on the application. Direct PhD requires a willing supervisor; admission committee circulates
the file. Ben Webster explicitly says he is open to Fall 2027 students but selective due to administrative
work/sabbatical; recommends bachelor’s applicants email him beforehand and apply MMath. His blanket
master’s-first advice differs from the department FAQ’s direct-PhD exception; ask which route fits. [s3] [s14]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Current central portal is grad.apply.uwaterloo.ca. Submit/pay, upload required items and track checklist.
Requests can be sent before final application; required documents and completed referee forms together make
the application complete. Do not follow legacy OUAC/Quest-only instructions if inconsistent with current portal.
[s4] [s5]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Admission deadline and degree rules are standing, not explicitly dated Fall 2027. OGS timeline and Webster
availability explicitly refer to 2027. Department funding amounts remain labelled 2024-25. [s1] [s8] [s10] [s14]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing rule: 7 January for Fall, for both MMath and PhD; no explicit 2027 year or time zone shown. All
supporting information must arrive by that date for full consideration. Do not interpret the later 1 April
Winter/remaining-space route as equal Fall funding consideration. [s1]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Departmental full consideration uses the application deadline. OGS 2027-28: intent 14 January 2027 at 4 pm
ET; award application and references 1 February 2027 at 4 pm ET. However, new international Fall entrants are
ineligible: they must already be registered in Waterloo graduate studies by 1 February 2027. [s1] [s10] [s11]
Reference receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
All application information, including three reference forms and supplemental answers, is due by the standing
7 January Fall deadline for full consideration; no separate grace period or 2027 clock/time zone is published.
[s1] [s6]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Required scores must support a complete application by the program deadline. Waterloo recommends testing
at least two months earlier and allows 4-6 weeks for delivery; the expected UChicago English exemption may
remove the language-test requirement. No separate GRE arrival grace period established. [s7] [s1]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal acceptance date was established in the public Pure Mathematics admissions/FAQ or central
how-to-apply pages; use the offer letter and request clarification before relying on April 15. [s1] [s3] [s4]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
If not exempt: program page lists TOEFL 4.5 overall with writing/speaking 5, or IELTS Academic 7.0 with
writing/speaking 6.5. Scores valid two years; TOEFL MyBest and IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted. Central
guidance also accepts specified Cambridge, CAEL, PTE and EFAS routes; consult applicable current score table.
[s2] [s7]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Expected exemption: at least three years of postsecondary education in the United States completed by
Waterloo program start qualifies regardless of F-1 status. This is an inference applying the explicit
country/length rule to UChicago; confirm three years of qualifying study. A generic English-medium letter alone
does not establish exemption. [s7]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
GRE scores are not required. Departmental FAQ expressly permits submitting strong GRE results and says they
may help; it does not distinguish General from Mathematics Subject in that answer. No mandatory numerical
threshold stated. [s3]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Declare all completed/incomplete postsecondary attendance. Upload current unofficial institution-issued
transcripts and degree certificates where awarded; do not submit a homemade grades table. Official
documents are requested after an offer. Non-English originals require certified translation including grading
scale; Canadian French documents need no translation. [s5] [s3]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Required for applicants from outside Canada, including UChicago: senior undergraduate and graduate

Course descriptions [Standing rule]
For the above required list, provide course content descriptions OR textbook names. No separate
syllabus-upload requirement or limit is published. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three references, at least two academic; Pure Mathematics recommends writers who can discuss
mathematical research and ability in detail. [s2] [s3]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Admission reference forms may be used for institutional/provincial/federal awards. OGS uses separately
emailed references, but a new international Fall 2027 entrant cannot enter Waterloo’s 2027-28 competition.
Other award-specific requirements depend on eligibility. [s6] [s10] [s11]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
During the application, enter referee details and send the request immediately; the portal also has a
send-request action for a saved referee. Public instructions establish an applicant-triggered request, not that
merely typing details silently sends it. [s4] [s5]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
No: the current how-to-apply workflow permits sending requests while completing the application, before fee
payment/submission. [s4]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Completed confidential online forms are automatically added to the application; applicant portal tracks
completion. Reminders are sent 7 and 14 days after the initial email and applicants can send reminders. Paper
or referee-email submissions are not accepted for admission. [s6] [s4]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Portal permits excluding an unsubmitted reference and replacing the referee, plus reminders. An already
submitted letter’s replacement or reuse across applications is not publicly guaranteed; ask
gradapply@uwaterloo.ca. Each program needs its own complete document set. [s5]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
Not listed as a separate required document on Pure Mathematics program checklist. Do not assume an
unsolicited CV upload is allowed; consult live checklist. No public program-specific length/format. [s2] [s5]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No separately titled SOP listed. Required supplemental questions cover mathematical preparation,
publications, supervision choices and additional information; see related fields. Portal calls these PSQ while
departmental page calls the form SIF. [s1] [s2]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Optional supplemental Question 6: faithful paraphrase - supply other information useful to the admissions
committee; maximum 500 words. No additional public formatting rule; enter N/A if inapplicable. [s1]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Supplement Question 4: one-page project/interest summary, required for PhD and optional for MMath;
Question 5 requires 1-3 proposed supervisors. The form is completed online and cannot be corrected after final
submission. [s1]

Research proposal [Standing rule]
No mandatory fully developed thesis proposal. Question 4 permits an outline of a potential Waterloo research
area; same one-page limit. A suitable scholarship statement may be reused. [s1]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Question 4 alternatively permits a one-page summary of a recently completed/in-progress project. No
requirement to upload the complete paper or thesis; no authority to substitute a link established. [s1]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Supplement Question 2 asks for authored/coauthored publications, including research papers, theses and
technical reports. No published length limit or paper-upload/link rule. [s1]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Use required supplemental course list described above; no public page/character maximum. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
No additional standard departmental-funding essay found. OGS requires a distinct package but is unavailable
to a new international Fall 2027 entrant under the current eligibility rule. Do not draft OGS materials on the
assumption admission makes you eligible. [s11] [s3]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Supplement Question 3 asks applicants not currently studying to describe professional activity since leaving
school. General upload formats: PDF/PNG/JPG/GIF/TIF; maximum 3500 KB, except designated writing samples
5000 KB and portfolios 30000 KB; filename restrictions apply. These limits do not authorize an unsolicited
sample. [s1] [s5]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Latest department figures explicitly labelled 2024-25: domestic MMath minimum CAD 30,150 and PhD CAD
31,500 annually; international support is higher to offset tuition, but its exact amount is not published.
University PhD floor is CAD 29,145/year effective 1 May 2026, with eligible international doctoral
tuition-difference award additional. These are gross packages including mixed funding, not net cash after
tuition. Request the 2027 international offer breakdown. [s8] [s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Department promises MMath support for three terms (12 months) and PhD for twelve terms, with possible
extension. University floor can cover four/five years depending on entry route; clarify direct-bachelor PhD
duration in the actual offer. [s8] [s9]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International admitted research students receive support and additional tuition-offset support. OGS
international competition excludes prospective applicants; the department’s general scholarship examples
must not override that current restriction. [s8] [s11]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full-time admission/enrolment, good academic standing and satisfactory TA duties. Department ordinarily
expects 5-10 TA hours/week. Funding may combine scholarships, research studentships and employment;
TA/GRA income has statutory deductions. Tuition is charged; a package is not a tuition waiver. [s8] [s9] [s25]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Standard financial support accompanies admission; offer letter gives components. Additional awards can
change funding and TA load. No separate standard departmental essay/reference identified. [s3] [s25]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Institutional awards, graduate research studentships, TA/GRA and eligible external awards; eligible

Pay attention to
• Waterloo has distinct Pure Mathematics, Applied Mathematics and Combinatorics & Optimization
applications; this dossier concerns Pure Mathematics.
• Direct PhD is possible but requires supervisor fit; MMath is a funded route, not an unfunded consolation
award.
• New international applicants are not eligible for Waterloo OGS 2027-28 despite the award having an
international category.
• Some official personal-page links redirect to Waterloo’s homepage; current paper sources were
independently located and institutional appointments cross-checked.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago mathematics bachelor’s can be assessed as equivalent to an honours mathematics degree; MMath
minimum 78%. Direct PhD without a master’s is explicitly possible in the departmental FAQ, with a willing
supervisor. A PhD applicant not offered direct entry is automatically considered for MMath. Formal eligibility
also depends on advanced mathematics preparation and grades; degree completion before enrolment is
necessary. [s2] [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose Pure Mathematics and identify 1-3 possible supervisors; contact referees at least four weeks ahead.
Start the application 2-4 weeks before the deadline to allow document/referee completion. Select thesis MMath
initially; research-paper transfer is possible later. For a direct PhD, resolve supervision fit before applying. [s1]
[s3] [s4] [s6]
Adviser contact [Conflict]
Identify 1-3 faculty on the application. Direct PhD requires a willing supervisor; admission committee circulates
the file. Ben Webster explicitly says he is open to Fall 2027 students but selective due to administrative
work/sabbatical; recommends bachelor’s applicants email him beforehand and apply MMath. His blanket
master’s-first advice differs from the department FAQ’s direct-PhD exception; ask which route fits. [s3] [s14]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Current central portal is grad.apply.uwaterloo.ca. Submit/pay, upload required items and track checklist.
Requests can be sent before final application; required documents and completed referee forms together make
the application complete. Do not follow legacy OUAC/Quest-only instructions if inconsistent with current portal.
[s4] [s5]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Admission deadline and degree rules are standing, not explicitly dated Fall 2027. OGS timeline and Webster
availability explicitly refer to 2027. Department funding amounts remain labelled 2024-25. [s1] [s8] [s10] [s14]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing rule: 7 January for Fall, for both MMath and PhD; no explicit 2027 year or time zone shown. All
supporting information must arrive by that date for full consideration. Do not interpret the later 1 April
Winter/remaining-space route as equal Fall funding consideration. [s1]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Departmental full consideration uses the application deadline. OGS 2027-28: intent 14 January 2027 at 4 pm
ET; award application and references 1 February 2027 at 4 pm ET. However, new international Fall entrants are
ineligible: they must already be registered in Waterloo graduate studies by 1 February 2027. [s1] [s10] [s11]
Reference receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
All application information, including three reference forms and supplemental answers, is due by the standing
7 January Fall deadline for full consideration; no separate grace period or 2027 clock/time zone is published.
[s1] [s6]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Required scores must support a complete application by the program deadline. Waterloo recommends testing
at least two months earlier and allows 4-6 weeks for delivery; the expected UChicago English exemption may
remove the language-test requirement. No separate GRE arrival grace period established. [s7] [s1]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal acceptance date was established in the public Pure Mathematics admissions/FAQ or central
how-to-apply pages; use the offer letter and request clarification before relying on April 15. [s1] [s3] [s4]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
If not exempt: program page lists TOEFL 4.5 overall with writing/speaking 5, or IELTS Academic 7.0 with
writing/speaking 6.5. Scores valid two years; TOEFL MyBest and IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted. Central
guidance also accepts specified Cambridge, CAEL, PTE and EFAS routes; consult applicable current score table.
[s2] [s7]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Expected exemption: at least three years of postsecondary education in the United States completed by
Waterloo program start qualifies regardless of F-1 status. This is an inference applying the explicit
country/length rule to UChicago; confirm three years of qualifying study. A generic English-medium letter alone
does not establish exemption. [s7]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
GRE scores are not required. Departmental FAQ expressly permits submitting strong GRE results and says they
may help; it does not distinguish General from Mathematics Subject in that answer. No mandatory numerical
threshold stated. [s3]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Declare all completed/incomplete postsecondary attendance. Upload current unofficial institution-issued
transcripts and degree certificates where awarded; do not submit a homemade grades table. Official
documents are requested after an offer. Non-English originals require certified translation including grading
scale; Canadian French documents need no translation. [s5] [s3]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Required for applicants from outside Canada, including UChicago: senior undergraduate and graduate

mathematics courses, grouped as algebra/logic, analysis, geometry/topology/number theory, and other
mathematics. [s1]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
For the above required list, provide course content descriptions OR textbook names. No separate
syllabus-upload requirement or limit is published. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three references, at least two academic; Pure Mathematics recommends writers who can discuss
mathematical research and ability in detail. [s2] [s3]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Admission reference forms may be used for institutional/provincial/federal awards. OGS uses separately
emailed references, but a new international Fall 2027 entrant cannot enter Waterloo’s 2027-28 competition.
Other award-specific requirements depend on eligibility. [s6] [s10] [s11]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
During the application, enter referee details and send the request immediately; the portal also has a
send-request action for a saved referee. Public instructions establish an applicant-triggered request, not that
merely typing details silently sends it. [s4] [s5]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
No: the current how-to-apply workflow permits sending requests while completing the application, before fee
payment/submission. [s4]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Completed confidential online forms are automatically added to the application; applicant portal tracks
completion. Reminders are sent 7 and 14 days after the initial email and applicants can send reminders. Paper
or referee-email submissions are not accepted for admission. [s6] [s4]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Portal permits excluding an unsubmitted reference and replacing the referee, plus reminders. An already
submitted letter’s replacement or reuse across applications is not publicly guaranteed; ask
gradapply@uwaterloo.ca. Each program needs its own complete document set. [s5]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
Not listed as a separate required document on Pure Mathematics program checklist. Do not assume an
unsolicited CV upload is allowed; consult live checklist. No public program-specific length/format. [s2] [s5]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No separately titled SOP listed. Required supplemental questions cover mathematical preparation,
publications, supervision choices and additional information; see related fields. Portal calls these PSQ while
departmental page calls the form SIF. [s1] [s2]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Optional supplemental Question 6: faithful paraphrase - supply other information useful to the admissions
committee; maximum 500 words. No additional public formatting rule; enter N/A if inapplicable. [s1]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Supplement Question 4: one-page project/interest summary, required for PhD and optional for MMath;
Question 5 requires 1-3 proposed supervisors. The form is completed online and cannot be corrected after final
submission. [s1]

Research proposal [Standing rule]
No mandatory fully developed thesis proposal. Question 4 permits an outline of a potential Waterloo research
area; same one-page limit. A suitable scholarship statement may be reused. [s1]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Question 4 alternatively permits a one-page summary of a recently completed/in-progress project. No
requirement to upload the complete paper or thesis; no authority to substitute a link established. [s1]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Supplement Question 2 asks for authored/coauthored publications, including research papers, theses and
technical reports. No published length limit or paper-upload/link rule. [s1]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Use required supplemental course list described above; no public page/character maximum. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
No additional standard departmental-funding essay found. OGS requires a distinct package but is unavailable
to a new international Fall 2027 entrant under the current eligibility rule. Do not draft OGS materials on the
assumption admission makes you eligible. [s11] [s3]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Supplement Question 3 asks applicants not currently studying to describe professional activity since leaving
school. General upload formats: PDF/PNG/JPG/GIF/TIF; maximum 3500 KB, except designated writing samples
5000 KB and portfolios 30000 KB; filename restrictions apply. These limits do not authorize an unsolicited
sample. [s1] [s5]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Latest department figures explicitly labelled 2024-25: domestic MMath minimum CAD 30,150 and PhD CAD
31,500 annually; international support is higher to offset tuition, but its exact amount is not published.
University PhD floor is CAD 29,145/year effective 1 May 2026, with eligible international doctoral
tuition-difference award additional. These are gross packages including mixed funding, not net cash after
tuition. Request the 2027 international offer breakdown. [s8] [s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Department promises MMath support for three terms (12 months) and PhD for twelve terms, with possible
extension. University floor can cover four/five years depending on entry route; clarify direct-bachelor PhD
duration in the actual offer. [s8] [s9]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International admitted research students receive support and additional tuition-offset support. OGS
international competition excludes prospective applicants; the department’s general scholarship examples
must not override that current restriction. [s8] [s11]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full-time admission/enrolment, good academic standing and satisfactory TA duties. Department ordinarily
expects 5-10 TA hours/week. Funding may combine scholarships, research studentships and employment;
TA/GRA income has statutory deductions. Tuition is charged; a package is not a tuition waiver. [s8] [s9] [s25]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Standard financial support accompanies admission; offer letter gives components. Additional awards can
change funding and TA load. No separate standard departmental essay/reference identified. [s3] [s25]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Institutional awards, graduate research studentships, TA/GRA and eligible external awards; eligible

international PhD students may receive IDSA covering the tuition differential above the minimum. Do not
assume NSERC eligibility from F-1 status. [s9] [s25]
Application fee [Standing rule]
CAD 150 nonrefundable per program through the applicant portal. [s4]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No Pure Mathematics or central graduate waiver procedure was found in the cited application pages. Another
department says fees cannot be waived, but that is not proof of every Math exception. Ask
pmgradadmin@uwaterloo.ca before payment; no waiver assumed. [s4]

Central program terminology PSQ versus departmental SIF; inspect live questions before drafting. Department
